_purpose: Round-1 approach cards for code-rendered strips (docs/code-rendered-strips-plan.md). Each card is one artistic approach on one case. Falsifiers are written before rendering. Shape: lib/foundry/strips/types.ts Approach.

approaches.name: Kinetic typography
approaches.direction: Words are the actors. Each causal step is a phrase that enters, compresses or pushes the next. Swiss grid, black on warm white, one red accent for the policy rate. Scale and weight carry causation.
approaches.falsifier: Reads as a slideshow of captions with no mechanism; the viewer cannot see what pushes what.

approaches.name: Bauhaus geometric construction
approaches.direction: Primary shapes on cream: a red circle (rate) grows, a blue bar (borrowing) shrinks, a yellow triangle (prices) tilts down. Constructivist diagonals. Shapes morph into each other along the causal chain.
approaches.falsifier: Abstract to the point of illegible: shapes move but the meaning of each shape is never anchored.

approaches.name: Isometric economy diorama
approaches.direction: A small isometric town: a central bank building, a bank, houses, a shop. A slow camera pan follows money as fewer coins flow when the rate dial turns. Soft pastel blocks with crisp outlines.
approaches.falsifier: A cute toy town where the camera move eats the 8 seconds and the mechanism is lost in props.

approaches.name: Comic panels with halftone
approaches.direction: Four panels reveal in sequence, each one causal step. Ben-day halftone dots, thick ink borders, caption boxes. The camera pushes panel to panel.
approaches.falsifier: Panels read as four separate jokes rather than one chain; text boxes push below the legibility floor.

approaches.name: Mathematical ink on dark
approaches.direction: Deep navy ground, chalk-white and pastel strokes drawn on as paths. Labels morph into the next quantity. A demand curve shifts left as the rate rises; elegant, calm, precise.
approaches.falsifier: Looks like a lecture slide: correct but static between draw-ons, with motion in under 3 seconds.

approaches.name: Nautical blueprint
approaches.direction: Cyan line on deep blue chart paper with a grid and depth soundings. Shipping lanes draw on and converge into the narrow strait; a dimension line measures the narrows. Technical callouts.
approaches.falsifier: A pretty map with no consequence: the price effect never appears.

approaches.name: Cut-paper layers
approaches.leonardoPrompt: seamless texture of handmade cream paper with subtle fibres and soft grain, flat lighting, no text, no objects
approaches.direction: Coastlines as stacked paper layers with cast shadows, tankers as paper cutouts sliding through the gap. Parallax camera drift. A paper price tag on a barrel lifts when the gap pinches.
approaches.falsifier: Shadow and parallax noise make the narrow gap hard to read at phone size.

approaches.name: Two-ink risograph
approaches.direction: Fluorescent pink and teal overprint with misregistration, halftone grain and stepped motion at 10 fps. Bold poster typography for the share-of-oil fact.
approaches.falsifier: Grain and misregistration bury the small labels; stepped motion reads as lag.

approaches.name: Low-poly 3D map
approaches.direction: Flat-shaded low-poly terrain and sea, a slow orbit down into the strait, tankers as simple prisms queuing. Labels as screen-space overlays, not 3D text.
approaches.falsifier: Software GL renders slowly or blank; or the orbit is pretty while the labels fall under the floor.

approaches.name: Particle flow field
approaches.direction: Thousands of glowing particles stream like oil along routes and squeeze through the strait. A disruption chokes the stream, and a price line on the side climbs. Black ground, amber particles.
approaches.falsifier: Becomes a screensaver: particles look great and explain nothing.

approaches.name: Copperplate cross-hatch engraving
approaches.direction: Sepia engraving: hatching builds tone on the arches and hills, the water channel inks in along its slope, with a tiny gradient triangle annotated like an old textbook plate.
approaches.falsifier: Hatching density turns to grey mush when downscaled; the slope is invisible.

approaches.name: Watercolour wash
approaches.leonardoPrompt: seamless texture of cold-press watercolor paper with a few faint pale blue and ochre washes, soft edges, no text, no objects
approaches.direction: Soft washes bleed in for hills and sky; the water appears as a blue wash travelling along the channel; ink lines stay minimal. Gentle and warm.
approaches.falsifier: Too soft: the gradient fact and the bridge never get a crisp read.

approaches.name: Exploded-view cross-section
approaches.direction: The bridge tiers separate along vertical axes to reveal the covered channel on top; leader lines label channel, arches and tiers. The camera tilts from the long profile to the section.
approaches.falsifier: Looks like a parts catalogue; the 'gravity alone across a valley' idea is lost.

approaches.name: Museum specimen cabinet
approaches.leonardoPrompt: empty dark wooden museum display cabinet interior with glass shelves and warm spotlight, front view, no text, no objects on shelves, no people
approaches.direction: Exhibits on shelves with typed museum label cards: a stone channel fragment, a gradient ruler, a valley model. A spotlight moves label to label in causal order.
approaches.falsifier: The cabinet backdrop dominates and the labels look like decoration.

approaches.name: Clay stop-motion feel
approaches.direction: Chunky rounded clay shapes with a subtle boil (seeded jitter per held frame), held at 12 fps. Water as a blue clay worm travelling downhill along the channel. Playful.
approaches.falsifier: The boil reads as a rendering bug, or the stepped timing feels broken rather than handmade.

approaches.name: Oscilloscope neon line
approaches.direction: One continuous green phosphor line on black: the pulse leaves the antenna, the echo returns, and a CRT trace shows the blip. Afterglow is computed from t, never accumulated.
approaches.falsifier: Glow filters wash out the labels; the time-to-distance step is never stated.

approaches.name: 8-bit pixel diagram
approaches.direction: A 160×90 pixel world scaled up with nearest-neighbour: pixel antenna, pixel plane, the pulse as a moving pixel ring, a chunky pixel font. Four-colour palette.
approaches.falsifier: The pixel font cannot meet the legibility floor; or it reads as a game, not an explanation.

approaches.name: Chalkboard lecture
approaches.leonardoPrompt: seamless texture of a dark green school chalkboard with faint erased chalk smudges, flat front view, no text, no drawings
approaches.direction: Chalk strokes with a grainy edge draw the antenna, the plane, arrows out and back, then write distance = c × t / 2 by hand. A teacher's underline lands on the result.
approaches.falsifier: Chalk texture makes thin strokes break up; the formula appears too late to read.

approaches.name: Sketchbook pencil on graph paper
approaches.direction: Pencil-grey jittered strokes (seeded) on graph paper; a margin note in handwriting style; arrows sketched out and back with tick marks counting microseconds.
approaches.falsifier: Jitter makes it look sloppy rather than personal; grey on graph paper lacks contrast.

approaches.name: 1940s field-manual diagram
approaches.leonardoPrompt: seamless texture of aged yellowed manual paper with faint foxing and fibres, flat lighting, no text, no stamps, no objects
approaches.direction: Two-colour print (black and olive) on aged paper, stencil and typewriter type, numbered figure callouts (FIG. 1, FIG. 2), a period-correct schematic of transmitter, receiver and echo path.
approaches.falsifier: Pastiche overwhelms clarity; small typewriter labels fall under the floor.

approaches.name: Broadcast scoreboard, leader-adaptive
approaches.leonardoPrompt: dark empty motorsport broadcast studio background with soft bokeh lights and asphalt texture, vertical composition, no text, no logos, no people, no cars
approaches.direction: TV timing-tower grammar: rank, name, wins, gap. The background tint follows the current leader's colour and cross-fades on a lead change. Rows slide on overtakes.
approaches.falsifier: Generic sports-graphics template; the lead changes do not feel like moments.

approaches.name: Race-track lanes
approaches.direction: A top-down track straight where each driver is a car-coloured lane marker whose distance down the track equals career wins. The camera follows the leader; the year is a gantry overhead.
approaches.falsifier: The track metaphor fights the comparison: lengths are hard to compare when the camera moves.

approaches.name: Split-flap departures board
approaches.direction: A mechanical split-flap board lists the top 10. Characters flip (computed per frame) when ranks change. Clattering rhythm, yellow on black, the year in a big flap clock.
approaches.falsifier: Flipping glyphs make the board unreadable mid-change; nothing reads as a race.

approaches.name: Neon arcade leaderboard
approaches.direction: Synthwave high-score table: glowing magenta and cyan, scanlines, an insert-coin title. Lead changes get a single burst.
approaches.falsifier: Gamer wallpaper: glow, scanlines and bursts bury the numbers.

approaches.name: Ball stack columns
approaches.direction: Each goal is a small ball dropping into a player's column. The columns rise like a ball pit; the camera re-frames as totals grow. Closed-form drops per frame.
approaches.falsifier: Too many balls to count; the camera reframing hides the leader.

approaches.name: Editorial newspaper chart
approaches.direction: Broadsheet restraint: serif headline, thin rules, a line chart of cumulative goals for the top players, direct labels at line ends, one annotation per record broken.
approaches.falsifier: Correct and calm but forgettable: the infographic post.

approaches.name: Big-number kinetic type
approaches.direction: The record-holder's total is a giant odometer numeral filling the frame; the holder's name swaps when the record changes hands; the challengers are small numbers chasing below.
approaches.falsifier: One number can't show a field: the race context is lost.

approaches.name: Rank-flow ribbons
approaches.direction: A bump chart drawing on through time: ribbons cross as ranks change; the leader's ribbon is thickest and brightest; names ride the ribbon heads.
approaches.falsifier: Spaghetti: too many crossings for phone size.

approaches.name: Belt passing down the timeline
approaches.direction: A championship belt (drawn in code, no logo) travels along a horizontal timeline, handed from champion to champion; each reign is a plinth whose width is its length. Vacancies are empty plinths.
approaches.falsifier: The belt animation is charming but the reign lengths are unreadable.

approaches.name: Fight-poster risograph
approaches.direction: 1970s fight-poster typography in two-ink riso: each reign gets a stamped 'CHAMPION' block with dates; a stack of posters accumulates, newest on top, stepped at 10 fps.
approaches.falsifier: Poster pastiche hides the time dimension; the cards blink before they can be read.

approaches.name: Reign Gantt with days counter
approaches.direction: A vertical Gantt of reigns scrolling with the year; a side ranking of cumulative days as champion reflows as the clock runs. Clean sans, gold accent for the current champion.
approaches.falsifier: Two charts in one frame split authority; neither reads.

approaches.name: Hand-drawn notebook chart
approaches.direction: Ballpoint-blue sketch on lined notebook paper: reign bars drawn as hatched pen strokes, names hand-lettered (in a script-like system font), margin doodles marking upsets.
approaches.falsifier: Looks like a student's notes, not a broadcast; hand lettering fails the floor.

approaches.name: Cut-paper skyline
approaches.leonardoPrompt: seamless texture of matte coloured construction paper with subtle fibres, neutral grey, flat lighting, no text, no objects
approaches.direction: Each country is a paper tower on one height scale; towers grow floor by floor with the debt; the camera tilts up as the tallest outgrows the frame; a ghost line marks the frame's earlier top.
approaches.falsifier: The camera tilt makes the scale change invisible, so growth looks flat.

approaches.name: Gauge cluster
approaches.direction: An instrument panel of dials, one per top country, needles showing debt as % of GDP with a redline at 100%, a digital readout of the USD total beneath each.
approaches.falsifier: Ten dials are too many to compare; the ranking is lost.

approaches.name: Treemap mosaic reflow
approaches.direction: Squarified treemap of the top debtors' share of the top-10 total, tiles reflowing smoothly year to year (interpolated rectangles), labels inside tiles that fit.
approaches.falsifier: Tiles jump between layouts; small tiles carry unreadable labels.

approaches.name: Orthographic globe with dated log
approaches.direction: A slowly turning globe (orthographic projection) where the top debtors glow by size; a dated log beside it lists the current top 5. No flags; country names only.
approaches.falsifier: Confetti geography: small rich countries invisible; rotation hides the leader.

approaches.name: Isotype pictograms
approaches.direction: Neurath-style rows of identical coin icons, one icon per fixed USD trillion; icons add and remove per year in steps; flat museum palette, sans caps.
approaches.falsifier: Early decades have under one icon per country, so the first half shows nothing.

approaches.name: Waffle grid of world share
approaches.direction: A 10×10 waffle of the top-10 combined GDP, each square coloured by country; squares hand over between countries as shares shift; a ranked legend beside it.
approaches.falsifier: Share hides growth: everything gets bigger but the waffle looks the same.

approaches.name: Bubble trails
approaches.direction: Each economy is a bubble moving up a log GDP axis over time, leaving a fading trail computed from its history; the year is a huge watermark behind.
approaches.falsifier: The log axis and trails confuse rank; the watermark competes with the data.

approaches.name: Bar race with ghost of the past
approaches.direction: A crisp horizontal bar race; behind each bar a thin ghost shows its value ten years earlier; a time warp gives busy decades more frames; the leader's bar wears the accent.
approaches.falsifier: Indistinguishable from the control: an ordinary bar race.
